title: First-use calibration ribbon and compact onboarding screenshots for Optimize toolkit
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a compact, first-use "calibration ribbon" and a set of screenshot assets that introduce Optimize toolkit recommendations (batching, KV/prefix caching, quantization profiles) in a lightweight, engineer-focused quickstart. Deliverables: Figma frames for calibration ribbon (3 width variants), 6 production-ready PNG/JPEG screenshots (desktop + mobile crops), copy variants for microcopy A/B test, annotated handoff notes for frontend and docs, and example overlay that demonstrates estimated token-savings and latency tradeoffs. Designs should support: (1) economy vs latency toggle, (2) recommended quantization presets with 'simulate' preview, (3) KV cache suggestion with prefix-snapshot visualization, and (4) dynamic batching suggestion with expected throughput meter. Prioritize clarity for first 3 minutes of user interaction and ensure screenshots are usable in marketing docs and product changelog.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with named frames and export slices for 6 screenshots (2 desktop, 4 mobile/compact)
Finalized microcopy (3 variants) and localization-ready label keys provided in handoff doc
Annotated JSON for engineers describing responsive breakpoints, CSS tokens, and accessibility contrast checks
Design review sign-off from PM (Diego Morales) and RL engineering reviewer (Sana Iqbal)
Screenshots exported at required dimensions and uploaded to design-exports bucket with clear filenames
